title: Claudine Barretto files cyberlibel complaint vs Cristy Fermin, Rommel Chika
summary: Actress Claudine Barretto filed Wednesday a cyberlibel complaint against veteran showbiz columnist Cristy Fermin and co-host Rommel Chika over statements that she claims damaged her reputation.
